description.value: You've pulled people back from the edge more times than the wastes have any right to allow. When you Administer First Aid to stabilize a dying creature, you can also remove the wounded condition entirely on a critical success, rather than merely reducing it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Changing what a critical success on Administer First Aid accomplishes (remove wounded entirely, instead of the action's normal reduction) is baked into the action's own script, not something a rule element can override.
